lines.sub: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty — “Artist”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty — Artist.

lines.sub: A card for mom, a picture for a post, a badge for a club — and no artist at hand.
lines.tts: A card for mom, a picture for a post, a badge for a club — and no artist at hand.

lines.sub: Say: “Draw a birthday card for mom.” I'll draw it myself — without third-party services.
lines.tts: Say: Draw a birthday card for mom. I'll draw it myself — without third-party services.

lines.sub: The card opens in the browser: “Save PNG” — and you can send it in a messenger or print it.
lines.tts: The card opens in the browser: Save PNG — and you can send it in a messenger or print it.

lines.sub: Want to change something — say it in words: “Add balloons and confetti.” I'll add them.
lines.tts: Want to change something — say it in words: Add balloons and confetti. I'll add them.

lines.sub: I can do animation too: “Snow over a city at night.” Tap “Record video” — and the clip is ready.
lines.tts: I can do animation too: Snow over a city at night. Tap Record video — and the clip is ready.

lines.sub: All works are in the “Gallery”, in the “Drawings” folder.
lines.tts: All works are in the Gallery, in the Drawings folder.

lines.sub: Turn on “Artist” in the studio, in “Plugins” — or right on the home screen, in the “Try a plugin” card.
lines.tts: Turn on Artist in the studio, in Plugins — or right on the home screen, in the Try a plugin card.
Dewiar is free, at dewiar dot pro.

lines.sub: See you in the next lesson!
lines.tts: See you in the next lesson!
